scope.market_definition: The U.S. Hospital Emergency Department Market encompasses the supply chain and services related to emergency medical care facilities within hospitals. Key participants include distributors, wholesalers, resellers, system integrators, service providers, and channel partners that facilitate the delivery of medical equipment, supplies, and technology to emergency departments across the United States.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Tri-Tec Monitors

###### The Cardiac Monitoring Specialists

###### Rentals / Sales / Service

###### 1-800-582-3348

Cardiac Monitors For Sale or Rent

[www.tritecmonitors.com][58]

Tri-Tec Monitors is a leading cardiac telemetry EKG monitoring and medical supply distributor for
new, used, and refurbished cardiac hospital equipment based near Memphis,TN and serving the greater
southeast region including the states of Tennessee, Alabama, Arkansas, Mississippi, Georgia, Texas,
Louisiana, Kentucky, Oklahoma, and Missouri. We offer reasonable rental programs and in-house
financing through our rent to own service. We have experience working with critical access hospitals
(CAH) and cost plus financial programs.  We service everything we sell and offer maintenance
contracts and extended warranties for all new and used equipment. We offer Free Technical Support on
everything we sell whether it is in or out of warranty. Tri-Tec Monitors is your one stop source for
the sale or rental of cardiac monitors and telemetry monitoring in Hospitals, Telemetry Floors,
Operating Rooms, Emergency Rooms, Cardiac Rehabilitation, Surgery Centers, Intensive Care Units,
(ICU’s), Long Term Acute Care Facilities, (LTAC), Drug Research Facilities, Doctors Offices, and
Veterinary Clinics. We sell and rent cardiac and telemetry and holter monitoring systems by such
brands as Edan Medical Instruments,  DMS, Infinium Medical, CardioVision, and CardioScan Holter
Systems.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

# CMR: The Emergency Department EHR Built by ED Clinicians, for ED Clinicians

#### Streamline patient care, enhance revenue capture, and ensure regulatory compliance with our
#### browser-based EDIS.

Designed and continually refined by seasoned ED physicians and nurses, CMR’s Emergency Department
Information System (EDIS) addresses every step of the patient journey—from triage to discharge.
Fully **browser-based**, CMR minimizes hardware costs and allows staff to document anytime,
anywhere.

[Request a demo][10]

# Highlights

CMR helps emergency departments of all sizes—from freestanding EDs and critical access hospitals to
multi-facility health systems—deliver efficient, high-quality patient care. Our intuitive,
clinically driven interface reduces time spent on documentation, speeds decision-making, and
maximizes charge capture. Backed by 24/7 clinical and technical support, CMR empowers your ED to run
at peak performance while meeting CMS, TJC, and industry requirements.

[
Learn more
][11]
* **Faster, Intuitive ED Workflow:** Chart and track patients with fewer clicks
* **Seamless Integration:** HL7 interfaces with your hospital HIS, billing, labs, imaging, and more
* **Proven ROI:** Increase revenue through complete documentation and reduced coding errors

# Features at a Glance

Whether you’re seeking to reduce wait times, streamline documentation, improve quality metrics, or
capture every billable service, CMR delivers the robust functionality you need—without disrupting
the fast-paced demands of emergency care.
* **Patient Tracking Whiteboard** for instant overview of patient status and location
* **Intuitive Clinician Documentation** with minimal clicks, guided prompts, and advanced clinical
  decision support
* **Integrated Ordering and Results** for labs, imaging, and pharmacy
* **Real-time Charge Capture **to reduce missed charges and improve revenue cycle efficiency
* **Seamless Interoperability **with your HIS, telehealth platforms, HIEs, and more
* **Scalable **from small rural facilities to large urban systems and freestanding EDs

ensure complete, compliant documentation
**Real-Time Charge Capture:** Automated prompts ensure no missed or undercoded charges

options, embedded with risk management guidelines
**Accuracy & Speed:** Precisely coded services and reduced claim rejections
**Clinical Decision Support:** Drug interaction checks, allergy alerts, and best-practice prompts

**Compliance Monitoring:** Hard stops and configurable alerts ensure staff capture mandatory
elements
**Triage to Disposition:** Streamlined triage forms, robust order management, real-time handoff

# About Us

#### Over 20 Years of Emergency Medicine Expertise

Headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, CMR was founded by experienced ED physicians and
operational leaders who recognized the need for an **EDIS built by clinicians, for clinicians.** For
more than two decades, we’ve continually evolved our product to address the real-world challenges
facing emergency medicine.What sets us apart is our **deep clinical roots** and unwavering
commitment to **customer support**. Our development and support teams collaborate daily with
practicing ED physicians, nurses, and IT professionals to continually advance and refine the system.
From single-site critical access hospitals to large multi-facility networks, our clients rely on CMR
for dependable performance and proven results.**Our Mission:** Empower emergency departments to

**Eiffel Medical Supplies,** located in Shenzhen Healthcare Industrial Park, is a professional
medical supplies manufacturer specializing in first aid kits, disposable medical supplies, and
portable healthcare devices. We provide reliable healthcare solutions for global distributors,
retailers, medical organizations, and private label brands.

quality standards. Our products comply with EU CE requirements and are registered with the U.S. FDA,

About Infirmary Health

# **The largest non-governmental healthcare system in the state of Alabama. **

Since 1910, Infirmary Health has provided the Gulf Coast region state-of-the-art and compassionate
care. Today, Infirmary Health is the largest private, not-for-profit health system in Alabama.
Infirmary Health is comprised of three acute care hospitals, one long-term acute care hospital, two
post-acute care facilities, four ambulatory surgery centers, and over 60 physician practice
locations. The health system is set apart by its 6,700+ team members, growing physician network, and
50+ service lines.

With state-of-the-art facilities close to home, we seek to provide excellent medical services to as
many people in the Gulf Coast region as possible. Our mission is LIFE: Leadership, Integrity,
Family, & Excellent Service, and our vision is to be the FIRST CHOICE for healthcare in the Gulf
Coast region.
* [ACHC Accredited]

**Proud award recipients at many of our locations.
[View All Awards][90] **
Our Services **Providing the highest quality care.**
[Medical staff person smiling with older man]

Our continuum of care includes wellness programs, inpatient and outpatient services, and
rehabilitation. Infirmary Health offers advanced-level care and cutting-edge equipment and
procedures. Our highly skilled and experienced team is prepared to serve patients across the
continuum of care.

* [Orthopaedics][92]
* [Primary Care][93]
* [Women's Health][94]

[View All Services][95]

Infirmary Cancer Care

Infirmary Cancer Care is an affiliate of the UAB O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, the only
NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center in Alabama. Our multidisciplinary team of experts
collaborate on each patient's case throughout their treatment. Patients can expect access to
high-quality cancer treatment, including clinical trials, close to home.

[Learn More][96]

the Alabama Gulf Coast **

We serve patients across southern Alabama, as well as the Florida panhandle and southern
Mississippi, with more than 700 physicians on the medical staff and 6,700+ employees.

  hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare
  facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and
  patient-centered care.
* A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities
  seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH
  standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for
  improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

## June 8, 2026:

## Haifa & Rambam are Again Under Attack



 

June 8:
* The Ministry of Health and Home Front Command, direct Rambam to open the Fortified Underground
  Emergency Hospital.
* Thousands of hospital staff have mobilized and are working intensively to prepare the underground
  hospital's infrastructure for full operations.
* Patients are already being transferred from unfortified aboveground facilities to the underground
  emergency hospital.
* Air-raid sirens are heard and Rambam staff and visitors seek shelter in fortified areas across the
  campus.


[][16]


#### DISCOVER RAMBAM 

 

Rambam Health Care Campus is a 1,100-bed world-class teaching hospital and Level-1 trauma center. As
the major referral center for the 2.7 million residents of Northern Israel, Rambam serves a diverse
patient population—including referrals from 12 district hospitals, defense and peacekeeping forces,
and patients from across Israel, the Mediterranean region, and around the world. The hospital
provides care across every medical discipline through advanced, specialized facilities located
across its campus.

West Virginia. We are owned by three not-for-profit healthcare providers: WVU Health System,

approach to insurance that will connect the bridge between the provider and the payer.

# Professional Medical Supplies Manufacturer OEM Partner

**Eiffel Medical Supplies,** located in Shenzhen Healthcare Industrial Park, is a professional
medical supplies manufacturer specializing in first aid kits, disposable medical supplies, and
portable healthcare devices. We provide reliable healthcare solutions for global distributors,
retailers, medical organizations, and private label brands.

quality standards. Our products comply with EU CE requirements and are registered with the U.S. FDA,
serving customers in more than 80 countries and regions, including North America, Europe, and

About Infirmary Health

# **The largest non-governmental healthcare system in the state of Alabama. **

Since 1910, Infirmary Health has provided the Gulf Coast region state-of-the-art and compassionate
care. Today, Infirmary Health is the largest private, not-for-profit health system in Alabama.
Infirmary Health is comprised of three acute care hospitals, one long-term acute care hospital, two
post-acute care facilities, four ambulatory surgery centers, and over 60 physician practice
locations. The health system is set apart by its 6,700+ team members, growing physician network, and
50+ service lines.

With state-of-the-art facilities close to home, we seek to provide excellent medical services to as
many people in the Gulf Coast region as possible. Our mission is LIFE: Leadership, Integrity,
Family, & Excellent Service, and our vision is to be the FIRST CHOICE for healthcare in the Gulf
Coast region.

Infirmary Cancer Care is an affiliate of the UAB O'Neal Comprehensive Cancer Center, the only

About Infirmary Health

# **The largest non-governmental healthcare system in the state of Alabama. **

Since 1910, Infirmary Health has provided the Gulf Coast region state-of-the-art and compassionate
care. Today, Infirmary Health is the largest private, not-for-profit health system in Alabama.
Infirmary Health is comprised of three acute care hospitals, one long-term acute care hospital, two
post-acute care facilities, four ambulatory surgery centers, and over 60 physician practice
locations. The health system is set apart by its 6,700+ team members, growing physician network, and
50+ service lines.

With state-of-the-art facilities close to home, we seek to provide excellent medical services to as
many people in the Gulf Coast region as possible. Our mission is LIFE: Leadership, Integrity,
Family, & Excellent Service, and our vision is to be the FIRST CHOICE for healthcare in the Gulf
Coast region.

## **NABH**
* NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers) is an organization in
  India that sets standards for quality healthcare services in various healthcare settings such as
  hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes. NABH accreditation is the recognition that a healthcare
  facility has met these quality standards and is committed to providing safe, effective, and
  patient-centered care.
* A NABH consultant is a professional who provides guidance and assistance to healthcare facilities
  seeking NABH accreditation. Their role is to help healthcare facilities understand the NABH
  standards and requirements, assess their current practices and procedures, identify areas for
  improvement, and develop and implement a plan to meet the NABH standards.

## Haifa & Rambam are Again Under Attack



 

June 8:

  Emergency Hospital.

  hospital's infrastructure for full operations.

  emergency hospital.

  campus.

the major referral center for the 2.7 million residents of Northern Israel, Rambam serves a diverse
patient population—including referrals from 12 district hospitals, defense and peacekeeping forces,
and patients from across Israel, the Mediterranean region, and around the world. The hospital
provides care across every medical discipline through advanced, specialized facilities located
across its campus.
